title: Top K Frequent Words
summary: Provide the k most frequent words from an array, sorted first by frequency in descending order, then lexicographically for words with the same frequency.
statement: Provide the k most frequent words from an array, sorted first by frequency in descending order, then lexicographically for words with the same frequency.
constraints: Rank higher frequency first and lexicographically smaller words first on ties.
reference_solution:
def top_frequent_words(words, k):
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(words)
    return sorted(counts,key=lambda word:(-counts[word],word))[:k]
